architecture.formula: q=normalize(x @ W.T + b); logits=(q.to(E.dtype) @ E.T).float()*exp(s) + vocab_bias
architecture.weight_orientation: activation rows are multiplied by W.T

claim_scope: controlled public recipe recreation; diagnostic comparison only; no replacement claim

data_contract.embedding_table: pre-normalized float32 public table, validated by pinned file hash
data_contract.historical_provenance_boundary: the retained TRR-0002 state has incomplete exact fit provenance; this is a fresh recipe recreation

padded_artifact_adapter.mask_rule: attention_mask must be contiguous right-padding; only active BOS/post-BOS rows are flattened

data_contract.split_check: fit and public-validation record IDs are checked before any label tensor is opened
data_contract.truth_policy: public auxiliary labels only; evaluator-private truth is not accepted by this loader

fit_recipe.gradient_clip_note: The historical attack.py source did not call clip_grad_norm_; this controlled recipe disables clipping (norm 0) and still fails closed on non-finite gradient norms.

selection.metric_definition: unweighted mean of per-group token accuracies over all public validation rows; one group reduces to aggregate accuracy
selection.validation_groups_source: sanitized style/group/source/dataset/domain fields in public validation record metadata; missing field is public

training_probe.full_fit_pass: one final full-fit capacity diagnostic after the last update
training_probe.role: fixed fit-only learning-curve diagnostic, never checkpoint selection

notes: No model fitting or model execution is authorized by this registration alone.
The historical-style arm intentionally retains hidden bias and learned scale while omitting vocabulary bias.
The vocabulary-bias arm is a controlled ablation, not a post hoc deletion from a fitted checkpoint.
Public validation curves and the retained historical A1 bridge are development diagnostics only.
Validation selection is style-balanced over all public validation rows; validation groups come from sanitized record metadata and are recorded in every fit evidence file.
The fit runner consumes the footing adapter manifest over the combined right-padded public activation artifacts and checks active lengths before flattening.

preparation_cost_reporting.cold_start: public tensor manifest/resource load and model initialization
preparation_cost_reporting.retained_state: W,b,s plus optional vocabulary bias; embedding table remains an external runtime resource
preparation_cost_reporting.steady_state: direct prediction includes the fixed public embedding table and no A2 or prefix calls

resource_guard.failure_policy: stop and preserve logs/artifacts; never score partial state
resource_guard.largest_geometry: full vocabulary logits at batch 512 with hidden width 2048; activations and normalized embedding table resident
resource_guard.memory_estimate: ~1.03 GiB BF16/FP32 activation storage plus ~1.05 GiB embedding table and optimizer/model/workspace overhead; qualify with >=8 GiB free and <=6 GiB reserved
